body.description: The sample student on the Quad Advisor splash page (specs/product/advisor.md "3. The page"). Jordan is made up and labeled "Sample" on every frame; the colleges are real IPEDS unit ids, and every college figure the page shows (name, city, admit rate, cost, deadlines, applicant interest, earnings, graduation rate) is read from the dataset and cited, never from this file. Levels are declared here, not estimated. Move titles and whys are the catalog's own words (lib/planner/moves-catalog.ts, lib/planner/list-shape.ts, lib/planner/interest.ts), deadline dates are the dataset's, and the test date is the cycle file's; tests/advisor-splash.test.mts checks each against the code and the data, so this file can't drift from the product. Offers' gifts and loans are the sample's own letters (illustrative); their cost of attendance is the college's published full price.
